verdict.rationale: Google Cloud runs a public status page covering its services (docs-23) plus Personalized Service Health with project-specific incident detail, alerts, API data and logs (docs-17), and users cite incident reports during outages (comm-16). Hands-on reports say the page lagged real outages by about an hour, showed green while production was down, and displayed inconsistent markers (comm-13, comm-16, comm-18), which weakens the 'owned in public' promise but does not disprove that the surface exists. Missing for 10: documented per-service incident history, documented post-incident reports/RCAs, and evidence of timely, accurate status reporting during outages.
